item.tib: zhi ba g.yung drung yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bsdus
item.coloph: de ltar zhi ba g.yung drung yongs rdzogs kyi dbang 'bum nang nas 'gro ba'i don du bsdus don tshangs pa'i lag len bde bar byas te/ chu gter rgya mtsho'i 'od mdangs ces bya ba/ dmu rigs rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis mtsho rnga brag dkar gyi mdun du brtsams pa dge legs 'phel//
